releaseNotes:
Kerlyss 1.4.2-beta.1

Performance: Faster Song Loading
- Stream fallback without manifest re-fetch
- Learned client order (remembers working YouTube client)
- Time limits (6s per client, 4s per Piped server)
- Smarter rate-limit trigger (3 videos in 1 minute)
- Persistent song -> YouTube video cache on disk
- Pre-loads next 2 songs
- Timing logs for debugging

Bug Fixes
- Failure counter was double-counted
- Premature completion detection uses furthest position
- BOM tolerance for beta.json/version.json
- Release metadata script writes without BOM

New Feature
- StartupGuard writes startup_error.log and opens in Notepad on Windows crash

Windows Packaging
- Bundles msvcp140.dll, vcruntime140.dll, vcruntime140_1.dll

For Beta Testers
- Settings -> Check for Beta Updates
- Normal check only offers stable
- Beta builds opt-in, same signing key as stable
